prompts.vine: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent modular sprite for the existing UNDERSTAR side-view game. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only: match its crisp hand-painted fantasy bark texture, small detailed edges, warm amber highlights and cool blue-green shadow palette. Do not reproduce the whole tree or any layout from it. Output a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no floor, no scene background, no black matte, no vignette, no text or symbols, no stars, crystals, fire or characters. The sprite must read clearly at 50 to 120 pixels in a 2D side-view game. Subject centered with generous transparent padding and entire silhouette visible. Primary request: one graceful, loose hanging vine sprig with a slender woody brown attachment at the top and a curved vertical trail of small moss-green and teal ivy leaves. Four little offshoots and a few warm gold leaf tips. Asymmetric natural silhouette, clear gaps between leaves, tapered trailing end. Restrained luminosity only on painted leaf edges, no diffuse glow cloud. This sprite hangs from a living tree and will gently sway about its TOP attachment point. It must not contain any large tree trunk or circular foliage bush.
